# Spinne Software

> The best software is not the one that does the most things. It is the one where everything works the way it should. The first product is Sparkle.

An Italian software company.

## Pages

- [The strength is in the structure](https://spinnesoftware.com/): An Italian software company. The best software is not the one that does the most, but the one where everything works as it should. The first is Sparkle.
- [The machine takes the labour. You keep the cut.](https://spinnesoftware.com/sparkle/): A desktop video editor. Background removal, segmentation, depth, mask tracking and transcription run on your own machine. Generative work uses the cloud.
- [The AI uses the same editor you use](https://spinnesoftware.com/how-we-build/): The assistant uses the editor's own tools, so anything it does is an ordinary change you can undo. What runs on your machine, and what needs the cloud.
- [An independent Italian software company in Rome](https://spinnesoftware.com/about/): An independent Italian software company in Rome. We build and run our own products instead of contracts, and we are clear about what we don't have.
- [Privacy — Spinne Software](https://spinnesoftware.com/privacy/): How spinnesoftware.com handles personal data. No cookies, no analytics, no third-party services, nothing sold or shared.
- [Transcribing video without uploading it](https://spinnesoftware.com/answers/transcribe-video-without-uploading/): Whisper runs on your machine. Which Sparkle setting keeps the audio there, why Auto doesn't, and what the eight-minute threshold actually decides.
